'''Cioral''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] and was located in the [[Cioral system/Legends|Cioral system]]. It was home of the [[Csapla family|House Csapla]], one of the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Ruling Families/Legends|Ruling Families]]; therefore, as with many other [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworlds]] of Ruling Families, Cioral was located on the [[Path of the Houses]], a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] in the Ascendancy's core territory. Cioral was also a heavily urbanized planet from which a half-dozen Chiss [[Agriworld/Legends|agricultural colonies]] were overseen.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Cioral was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square F-8.<ref name="TEA" />
